newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya coffee prices mixed at weekly auction.
newsitem.headline: Kenya coffee prices mixed at weekly auction.

text.p: Kenyan coffee prices were mixed at the weekly auction in Nairobi, auction officials said.
Grade ABs averaged $388 per 50 kg (110 lb) compared to $394 last week while grade AAs averaged $429 from $408.

They said there was good support for the unwashed "buni" coffee -- of lower quality. "I actually think the market might hold steady. Originally buni never had any demand, but today there was some good demand for it," a trader said.
The Coffee Board of Kenya sold 28,000 60-kg bags of coffee compared to 34,840 bags sold last week.
